newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Ford to recall 100,00 cars in Brazil.
newsitem.headline: Ford to recall 100,00 cars in Brazil.

text.p: The Brazilian unit of Ford Motor Co. will recall 100,000 cars beginning Friday to replace faulty fuel lines, a Ford Brasil spokesman said Thursday.
The spokesman, who asked not to be named, said Ford would recall 100,000 Escort and Versaille models whose motors were supplied by Volkswagen AG's Brazilian unit.

The Ford spokesman and newspaper reports said Volkswagen's Brazilian unit was preparing to recall 500,000 of its models. But a Volkswagen official was not immediately available to confirm the reports.

"It seems the fuel lines may prematurely crack, so we are replacing them with others made from a different material," the Ford spokesman said. "Obviously we are responsible for our cars and we are not blaming Volkswagen at all."
Ford has registered 12 cases where the lines cracked, causing small fires in the cars but no serious injuries, he said.
Ford will recall Escort models produced in Brazil between May 1994 and September 1996 and Versaille models built between February 1993 and September 1996.
The spokesman said changing the fuel lines was a simple job that would take no more than 15 minutes.
The 100,000 cars being recalled represents about 45 percent of Ford's annual vehicle output in Brazil, he said.
Volkswagen is Brazil's largest automaker, producing more than 550,000 cars a year.
